confidence_contract.multiplicity_correction: Bonferroni across 10 thresholds and 3 seeds; alpha = 0.05/30
confidence_contract.selection: within each seed, maximize safe positive coverage among thresholds satisfying adjusted group upper error bound and zero accepted unknowns; ties choose higher threshold; no qualifying threshold means always abstain
confidence_contract.group_failure: any unsafe accepted nonexact query in group; unknown acceptance prevents qualification
confidence_contract.assumptions: Clopper-Pearson arithmetic conditional on independent Bernoulli group outcomes; purposive templates and shared lineages do not establish that assumption. No population guarantee. Lineage bound reported separately.

provenance_flags: possible pretraining overlap with public pair data
seed_selection: first listed seed 11 is primary, prespecified; other seeds report spread only
